title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claim Acceptance Entry: Desk Systems Reference
content:
**Subject.** The accepted-claim deductible is the deductible recorded when the desk accepts a reported Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim. It is fixed by the accepted-claim deductible rule for a claim that is the only claim of its occurrence, while a claim that shares its occurrence reference with another vehicle's claim on the same policy is fixed under the one-deductible-per-occurrence rule instead.

The acceptance is the entry by which a reported claim comes to carry an accepted coverage decision: the coverage part the claim is accepted under and the deductible that applies to it are written onto the claim file together.

## Business effect

| Before the entry | After the entry |
|---|---|
| The claim file shows the loss report | The claim file also shows an accepted coverage decision, dated today, with its coverage part and its deductible and no denial ground |
| — | That accepted decision is the claim's latest coverage decision, seen by the customer and the desk when reviewing the claim |
| — | Nothing is paid by the entry |

## The entry tool

**Tool:** `record_claim_acceptance_ec9cfb06`

**Capability.** Records the claims desk's decision accepting a reported physical damage claim, with the coverage part it is accepted under and the deductible that applies to it. One call adds one accepted coverage decision to the claim's file.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_number` | The claim number of the reported claim being accepted, as shown on the claim's loss report entry, read from the claim file | Text identifier |
| `coverage_part` | The coverage part the claim is accepted under | One of `collision` or `comprehensive` |
| `deductible_amount` | The deductible recorded on the accepted claim | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when no deductible is charged |

Enum values of `coverage_part`:
- `collision` — the loss was a collision with another vehicle or object, a rollover or a hit-and-run collision.
- `comprehensive` — every other covered cause of loss (theft, vandalism, fire, hail, wind, flood, falling objects, glass breakage, hitting an animal).

**Return.** A receipt with `decision_id` (reference of the new coverage decision entry), `claim_number` (the claim decided), `coverage_decision` (always `accepted`), `coverage_part` (as recorded), `deductible_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, as recorded) and `decided_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying `decision_id` means the acceptance is on the claim file.

*Hypothetical illustration of the receipt shape:* a call for claim number CLM-0001 under `comprehensive` with a deductible of 250.00 returns a receipt naming that claim, `coverage_decision` accepted, `coverage_part` comprehensive, `deductible_amount` 250.0 and today's date as `decided_on`.
